CustomField.description: CJ: Created for NZC Data Gap BEI Calculation Implementation, Purpose: To calculate Active Duration of site within year.
CustomField.formula: IF(2022 == YEAR( Expiry_Date_1__c), (Expiry_Date_1__c- DATE(2022, 1, 1)+1), IF(2022 == YEAR( Expiry_Date_2__c), (Expiry_Date_2__c- DATE(2022, 1, 1)+1), IF(2022 == YEAR( Expiry_Date_3__c), (Expiry_Date_3__c- DATE(2022, 1, 1)+1), IF(2022 == YEAR( Expiry_Date_4__c), (Expiry_Date_4__c- DATE(2022, 1, 1)+1), IF(2022 == YEAR( Expiry_Date_5__c), (Expiry_Date_5__c- DATE(2022, 1, 1)+1), IF(2022 == YEAR( Expiry_Date_6__c), (Expiry_Date_6__c- DATE(2022, 1, 1)+1), 365) ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Duration
